title: 🎁 You Can't Out-Give God
subtitle: Let me share one of the sweetest things I've learned.

intro.title: A Lesson in Giving
paragraphs: Whether it's tithing or giving your time and skills, giving can seem impossible. I understand that feeling. But I can honestly say I have never given God more than He has given back to me. Time and time again, when I answered the call to give, the blessing overflowed. And when I let fear or greed hold me back, whatever I thought I'd saved, I ended up spending anyway.
I'm so grateful for how He has provided, and I want you to know that joy too.

verses.text: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.
Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom.
There is that scattereth, and yet increaseth; and there is that withholdeth more than is meet, but it tendeth to poverty.

blocks.title: A Thought to Carry With You
paragraphs: Give with a cheerful heart, and watch what He does with it. 🌾

footer.heading: Give With a Cheerful Heart
footer.text: May you know the joy of giving and the gratitude of seeing how God provides.

card.title: You Can't Out-Give God
card.summary: A personal reflection on giving with faith, gratitude, and a cheerful heart.
